title: Surface-water quality assessment across a river–lagoon continuum in central Vietnam using parameter-based analysis, PCA, and VN_WQI
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6VA00161K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nguyen Dinh Phuoc, Le Trung Hieu, Hoang Thai Long, Nguyen Van Hop, Ho Xuan Anh Vu, Felix Bachofer, Dominic Sett, Nguyen Duc Cuong, Nguyen Dang Giang Chau
Surface-water quality in Thua Thien Hue, Vietnam, was assessed using parameter-level analysis, PCA, and VN_WQI. The framework identified seasonal hotspots and supports adaptive monitoring and water governance.
